core_obligations: Open locus: the locus where the dimension bound holds is open and detected at a finite level.
Limit-nonempty: if the bound failed at the limit, the failure locus is a nonempty closed set limiting from finite levels (limit-closed-nonempty engine).
Fibre dimension contradiction: cutting by a closed immersion and applying the Noetherian fibre dimension theorem at a finite level gives the contradiction.
difficulty_reason: Open locus + limit-nonempty + closed-immersion fibre dimension contradiction; three engines with an honest dimension bookkeeping across the index shifts.
